data.name: Wetrix
data.detailed_description:
Wetrix is a unique puzzle experience where you must control the landscape and master the elements.

Rain constantly falls from the sky, and your goal is to reshape the terrain to contain the water before it floods the land. Build dams, carve valleys, create lakes, and carefully manage the terrain to keep the rising waters under control.

But nature doesn’t make things easy. Earthquakes reshape the ground, storms unleash torrential rain, and lightning can destroy your carefully constructed barriers. Only smart planning and quick reactions will allow you to survive the ever-changing environment.

Combining strategic terrain building with dynamic weather systems, Wetrix delivers a relaxing yet challenging puzzle experience where every decision can mean the difference between calm waters and total disaster.

Can you master the elements and keep the flood at bay?

Key Features

🌧 Dynamic Weather System
Rain, storms, earthquakes, and lightning constantly change the battlefield.

🧩 Strategic Terrain Building
Raise land, build dams, and reshape the environment to control the flow of water.

💧 Water Physics Gameplay
Manage lakes and reservoirs while preventing dangerous floods.

🎮 Easy to Learn, Hard to Master
Simple mechanics create deep strategic challenges.

🌍 Ever-Changing Puzzle Field
No two rounds play exactly the same as weather and terrain evolve.
